description:
### 🔧 Chore Summary

Implement MCP server OAuth authorization UX in the new React UI: surface success inline above fetched tools/resources/prompts. Surface failure as a dialog on the MCP server page with a button to retry on click. Represent the dismissed-failure state for the MCP server as an "Authorization needed" status. There should be a button next to this status that the user can click to retry.  [Design](https://www.figma.com/design/H2Dr9QPvRVxCe92V8URvGT/Refiring?m=auto&node-id=2806-3624&t=4dhMJrfiiuGienJs-1)

---

### 🧱 Area Affected

Choose the general area(s) that this chore affects:
Other: Frontend (React UI rewrite, mcpgateway/static/app/)

---

### ⚙️ Context / Rationale

Co-locating "did authorization succeed?" with "what tools did we get?" matches the user's goal of connecting a MCP server and accessing it's tools, resources, and prompts available. A dialog for failures keeps the user in context and makes retry a one-click action.

 Proposed approach                                                                                                                            
   
  1. Success: on the MCP server detail page, show an inline success indicator and the freshly fetched tools on the same screen. Authorize and refresh tools are distinct, re-runnable actions on the page so users can re-trigger either independently.                                  
  2. Failure: render a dialog on the server page with the provider-supplied reason and a Try again button.                                     
  3. Dismissed failure: the server's status badge becomes Authorization needed, with a button that the use can click to retry.                                                                                                                                             

---

### 📦 Related Make Targets

Reference any relevant Makefile targets that are involved, if applicable. Ex:

  - make dev - run the dev server while iterating
  - make build-ui - rebuild the SPA bundle after changes

---

### 📋 Acceptance Criteria

  - React MCP server detail page shows OAuth success inline and renders fetched tools on the same screen
  - OAuth failure surfaces as a dialog with the provider-supplied reason and a retry action                                 
  - "Authorization needed" is shown for the MCP if the dialog is dismissed and authorization has not been completed successfully. The user can click a button to retry. 

---

### 🧩 Additional Context

- Parent epic: #4093 (frontend refactor — React + Shadcn replacing HTMX + Alpine.js)
